- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/mobile-payment-element-link`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/mobile-payment-element-link, both captures describe Link in the default card form of Mobile Payment Element for native iOS, Android and React Native. It can autofill for existing Link customers even if they originally stored information with a different merchant. The guide calls for a Mobile Payment Element integration using what it calls the latest Stripe Mobile SDK, enabling Link in Dashboard, and activating dynamic payment methods with the latest API or automatic_payment_methods at PaymentIntent creation (old raw lines 6-22 and new raw lines 7-23). Link authenticates using email and phone. Optional defaultBillingDetails passes name, email and phone into iOS or Android PaymentSheet configuration or the React Native initPaymentSheet call. Prefill is separate from authentication and establishes no payment outcome. Sandbox Link accounts use a valid email, and the mobile guide says to enter 000000 when prompted (old raw lines 24-73 and new raw lines 25-74). source-stripe-mobile-payment-element-link.md accurately recaps the platform hooks, but collapses the dynamic-method alternatives and overstates the web OTP difference.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/mobile-payment-element-link, the move from the iOS-targeted link to general mobile navigation, extra build-an-app link, iOS screenshot CDN reference, heading spacing and list numbering are presentational or navigational. They establish no new platform support or behavior (old raw lines 6-22 and 71-77, new raw lines 7-23 and 72-79). Preserve both dates, the default card-form Link prompt and optional platform-specific prefill, and keep the Android sample's malformed let declaration qualified (old raw lines 39-54, new raw lines 40-55). In source-stripe-mobile-payment-element-link.md and its reciprocal Link concept, preserve the latest-API or explicit PaymentIntent automatic_payment_methods alternatives and distinguish the separate API-default and compatibility evidence from the mobile SDK prerequisite. Keep 000000 as the documented mobile sandbox instruction and warn reciprocally that the separate web Payment Element sandbox table reserves 000001 invalid, 000002 expired and 000003 maximum attempts, with other six-digit codes succeeding. Web reserved outcomes do not establish mobile or live acceptance. Default card-form prompting, optional prefill and a customer authentication step alone provide no guarantee of Link eligibility, successful payment or settlement.
